## Description

Tracks multi-scale connected component persistence (Betti-0) across hierarchical correlation distance thresholds to detect the sudden fusion of asset clusters, signaling systemic credit and equity contagion.

## Where it may fit

Pre-crash market environments, systemic credit crunches, cross-asset correlation breakdown detection.

## Vehicles

Tail-Risk Hedge Funds, Institutional Risk Management Desks, Global Macro Funds.

## Required data

Rolling cross-asset correlation matrices, multivariate asset return time series.

## Caveats

Hierarchical distance thresholding requires stability across sliding window lengths.
